historical_reviews.deepseek: A read-only eth0 query cannot execute the source's DHCP-source mutation or cover eth1, actual lease ownership, reconnection and restoration.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly treats management address change as service-impacting and requires an alternate recovery path plus lease correlation by MAC.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: DHCP enablement and address acquisition are separate facts. The decisive evidence is a lease for the exact BMC MAC on the intended VLAN plus successful identity-verified reconnection. A populated address field may be stale, link-local or inherited from another source.

original_test_intent: Change an approved BMC LAN channel to DHCP, prove the expected server assigns a valid address to the correct MAC and management remains reachable, then restore the documented network baseline.
original_method: Identify channel/port/MAC/VLAN and current configuration, validate the controlled DHCP scope and alternate recovery path, mutate only one approved channel through a protected interface, correlate source/readback and lease data, reconnect to the same BMC, verify routing/ACLs, then restore and re-read the original settings.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the network mapping and approved DHCP scope; an operator authorizes the address change, confirms alternate recovery and owns restoration and verdict.
required_inputs: Controlled DHCP scope/reservation and expected lease
Static/baseline restore values and protected credentials
safety_requirements: Do not depend solely on the old IP
Protect credentials and validate the BMC identity after reconnect
Stop on duplicate/unexpected address or wrong VLAN
Never automatically retry a lost management path
agent_execution_scope: Validate DHCP scope and unused reservation
Apply DHCP to one channel after approval
engineer_actions: Approve target channel and DHCP network

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The eth0 GET is useful pre/post evidence only; it cannot set DHCP, prove channel mapping or lease ownership, and its TLS/secret handling is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the supported protected per-channel DHCP mutation only after mapping and recovery checks, then verify the lease by MAC, reconnect to the same BMC and restore the full baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute estimates and listed channel concept remain; each channel requires separate approval and logs are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record the exact interface baseline, mutation time, DHCP discover/offer/ack or server lease, assigned tuple, reachability identity and full restoration as one traceable transition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds channel identity, service continuity and recovery rather than merely displaying an address.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: DHCPv4 enabled plus an address field does not prove a fresh authorized lease or reachable management path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The active session can disappear immediately after the source change; alternate console or another independently verified interface is mandatory.

project_override_considerations: The Project must confirm the eth0/eth1 channel mapping and whether both interfaces require separate trials. Never mutate all channels together or retain the DHCP state unless it is the approved baseline.
expected_evidence: Approved target/channel/MAC/VLAN and original network baseline
Controlled DHCP scope/reservation and server lease evidence
Protected source mutation and complete interface readback
Same-BMC identity plus gateway/DNS/HTTPS/IPMI reachability timeline
Restored per-interface baseline and no-unrelated-change diff
Preserved audit/SEL/network logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require DHCP acquisition. The unproven channel mapping and missing lease details are prerequisites rather than competing scopes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mapping, DHCP scope, alternate recovery and restore values are normal network inputs; execution blocks only if they cannot be established safely.

review_improvement: Changes a read-only partial observation into a controlled, MAC-correlated DHCP transition with independent reachability and restoration proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BMC may report DHCP enabled before a valid lease exists, and an address alone does not prove it belongs to the intended server or VLAN. Matching server lease data to the physical interface MAC and then authenticating the reconnected BMC identity closes both attribution gaps. Restoration must include source, address, gateway, VLAN and DNS, not only the IP field.
